canh: Pudding Lane, London, 01:00 on Sunday 2 September 1666, a baker's shop
loi_cau: Sunday, the second of September 1666. At about one in the morning, fire breaks out in Pudding Lane, in the house of Thomas Farriner, baker to the King.
mo_ta: The image accurately depicts the interior of Thomas Farriner's bakery on Pudding Lane in 1666, showing dough, sacks of flour, a traditional brick oven, and kindling catching fire with period-appropriate furnishings.
